##Part B
```{r}
#B1

students<- data.frame(
 id= c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8),
 name= c("Alice", "Bruno", "Chen", "Dana", "Elif", "Farid", "Grace", "Hiro"),
 sex= c("F", "M", "M", "F", "F", "M", "F", "M"),
 section= c("A", "B", "A", "C", "B", "C", "A", "B"),
 midterm= c(78, 85, 92, 67, 74, 88, 95, 59),
 final= c(82, 79, 96, 71, 80, 91, 93, 65),
 attendance= c(95, 88, 100, 72, 90, 85, 98, 60),
 stringAsFactors = FALSE
)

```

```{r}
#B2

str(students)
dim(students)
colnames(students)
summary(students)

```

```{r}
#B3

students$average <- round((students$midterm + students$final) / 2, 1)
```

```{r}
#B4
students$passed <- (students$average >= 70) & (students$attendance >= 75)
```

```{r}
#B5
 students$standing <- ifelse(
   students$average >= 90,
   "Honors",
   ifelse(students$average >= 75, "Good", "Needs Support")
 )
```

```{r}
#B6
scores <- c(90, 73, 55, 40)
classify <- function(score) {
  if (score >= 85){
    return("Distinction")
  }else if (score >= 70){
    return ("Merit")
  }else if (score >= 50){
    return ("Pass")
  }else{
    return ("Fail")
  }
  }
  
```

##Part C
```{r}
#C1
new_students <- data.frame(
  id= c(9, 10),
  name= c("Ines", "Jamal"),
  sex= c("F", "M"),
  section= c("C", "A"),
  midterm= c(81, 70),
  final= c(84, 68),
  attendance= c(92, 80),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

students$passed <- (students$average >= 70) & (students$attendance >= 75)
students$standing <- ifelse(
   students$average >= 90,
   "Honors",
   ifelse(students$average >= 75, "Good", "Needs Support")
 )
ncol(students)
ncol(new_students)
students_all <- rbind(students, new_students)
students_all

```

```{r}
#C2
quiz <- c(8, 7, 10, 6, 7, 9, 10, 5, 8, 6)
students_all <- cbind(students_all, quiz)
class(students_all)
```

```{r}
#C3
m <- cbind(midterm = students_all$midterm, final = students_all$final)
m <- rbind(m, mean = colnMeans(m))
```

```{r}
#C4

tryCatch(
  rbind(students, bad),
  error = function(e){
    message("rbind error caught successfully: ", e$message)
    NULL
  }
)
```
